format: html

```{r}
## package installation
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("googlesheets4")
install.packages("ggplot2")

library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#importing the datasheet from google sheets
growthCurve <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1b7LSO0ekXlpirAFBT_dzdURvNLGnmCvSjaBsxOryJKY/edit?gid=0#gid=0")
```

```{r}
#practice visualizations 
ggplot(growthCurve, aes(x = minutes, y = opticalDensity, color = bacteriaName, group = bacteriaName)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Time Incubating (Minutes)", y = "Optical Density", color = "Bacterial Strain") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("tomato", "goldenrod1", "lightblue","plum", "darkolivegreen3", "pink","hotpink2", "darkslategray4", "olivedrab")) +
  theme_minimal()
```
